set_model_name: set the model name used in AOTAutograd graph compilation logging
get_aot_graph_name: get the formatted name of the graph currently being compiled by AOTAutograd
track_graph_compiling: track graph compilation context with aot_config and graph_name as a context manager
setup_stacktrace_preservation_hooks: setup autograd hooks to preserve fx stack traces during backward pass
describe_input: describe an input index as parameter/buffer or plain input based on aot_config
